intro:
Howdy all! This is a practice issue. Every item in it is made up, so click anything, drag it, change it or remove it: nothing real is touched, and Save to the archive stays off.

The sections below show one of everything: a Date card event, a research box of each kind, a featured event, pictures, and both kinds of callout.

Thanks for practicing!

callouts.title: Nominate a speaker for the Imaginary Lecture Series
callouts.text: Know someone who gives a great talk about research that never happened? Send a name and a sentence. The Pretend Committee meets on a date to be made up.

callouts.title: Share something with the ERC
callouts.text: Research, an event, an announcement: if it belongs in the newsletter or on the Policy Exchange, send it our way. The ERC team reviews everything before it goes out.

fields.title: Do Hallway Posters Raise Test Scores? Evidence from 400 Imaginary Schools
fields.summary: In 400 schools that do not exist, hallways were papered with motivational posters for a year. Scores did not move, attendance did not move, and the posters faded. This brief explains why the Pretend Education Agency should spend its imaginary dollars elsewhere.

fields.title: The Tabletop Cohort: Five Years of Pretend Teachers in Three Made-Up States
fields.authors: Sam Placeholder, Ada Example, Jo Fictional
fields.summary: This report follows 3,000 invented teaching candidates from application to classroom across three states that appear on no map. Most finish, many stay, and the chart beside this text was drawn to look like a chart. Every number in it was made up for practice.

fields.title: A Journal Article That Never Was: Attendance at Schools That Do Not Exist
fields.summary: Published in the Journal of Made-Up Findings, this article asks whether students attend schools that are not there. They do not. The methods section is two sentences long.

fields.title: ERC Explains: What a Practice Issue Is For
fields.summary: A practice issue lets you try every part of the builder without touching anything real. Move a section, change a title, remove an item and put it back, pick a layout for a picture. When you are done, start the next issue.

fields.title: The ERC Practice Fellowship
fields.meta: Applications due never | Everyone is eligible
fields.summary: A year-long fellowship in which nothing is required and nothing is awarded. Fellows meet at the Pretend Pavilion on a schedule to be made up.

fields.location: Hypothetical Hall, Room 101, College Station, TX
fields.summary:
Moderated by **Dr. Ada Example**

Three invented scholars (**Dr. Sam Placeholder**, **Dr. Jo Fictional** and **Dr. Nobody in Particular**) discuss a classroom that has never been built. Imaginary drinks will be provided.

fields.title: ERC EdTalk with Dr. Sam Placeholder
fields.summary: Dr. Placeholder presents a book that has not been written on a topic that has not been chosen. Lunch is imaginary; please RSVP anyway, for practice.
